citations.title: Annual Leave Policy
citations.snippet:
Employees may carry over up to 5 unused annual leave days into the next calendar year. Carried-over days must be used by 31 March, after which they expire unless the Head of People has approved an exception in writing.

The leave system uses carried-over days before the current year's allocation. Employees submit exception requests by 15 March, describing the operational reason leave could not be taken. A manager's verbal assurance does not extend the expiry date. Approved exceptions state a replacement deadline and are retained with the leave record. Ordinary workload alone does not automatically qualify for an extension.

citations.title: Travel and Expenses Policy
citations.snippet:
Meals during approved overnight business travel are reimbursable up to SGD 65 per person per day, including taxes and service charges. Alcohol and meals already included in a hotel or event booking are not reimbursable.

The daily meal allowance is a cap on actual spending, not an automatic cash payment. Hotel accommodation is capped at SGD 220 per room per night before taxes. A higher hotel rate requires the Finance Director's written approval before booking, supported by evidence that suitable rooms are unavailable within the cap. Employees record each meal separately and attach receipts. Team meals must identify the attendees and the business purpose so Finance can avoid duplicate claims.
